title: The Apothecary's Assistant
author: Allyson Gray
description:

Friday: 11 a.m. – 11 p.m.
Saturday: 12:30 p.m. – 3:21 p.m.

This game is meant to be played over a minimum of six sessions of approximately 5 minutes each, across a period of multiple days or weeks.

NOTE: The game's date system had to be restructured after IFComp—it's now roughly playable again as of May 20, 2026, but both the upgraded mechanics and the new framing narrative will still be in a "beta" state for the near future (not thoroughly tested or content-complete yet).
